result.summary: The main interface is generally well-structured, but there are a few layout inconsistencies regarding content clipping and alignment.

issues.description: The 'Popular right now' card for Tokumaru Ramen Bar is missing its bottom border radius, causing a sharp corner that clashes with the rounded design of the other cards in the app.
issues.suggestion: Apply border-radius styling to the bottom corners of the container to match the top corners and other UI elements.

issues.description: The '-20%' label in the bottom card is vertically misaligned relative to the card's top edge, making it appear awkwardly positioned.
issues.suggestion: Adjust the top padding or margin of the discount badge to center it visually within its container area.
